shots.line: You pull away from pump six. A light comes on. A little red door on your dashboard.
shots.scene: ECU DASH: speedometer low arc and door diagram. Locked-off camera.
shots.purpose: Anomaly in the first frame. The 5 mph trigger is visible but unexplained (seed for the ending).
shots.visual_change: Needle rises 0→5 mph. At exactly 5 the RL segment lights red.

shots.line: Ten minutes later, it's still on. Rear left. The door behind you. Nobody has opened it in weeks.
shots.scene: Medium interior from the passenger seat toward YOU. The rear-left door is visible over YOU's shoulder. 0.4 s cross-fade in (time passage).
shots.purpose: Geography: the warning is the door directly behind YOU, a door nobody uses.
shots.visual_change: Rear-left door looks shut from inside.

shots.line: You'll want to pull over and slam it shut. Everyone does.
shots.scene: Close-up YOU, three-quarter front.

shots.line: Rule one. Don't pull over.
shots.scene: Rule card over the DASH, dimmed to 25%.

shots.line: A loose door flickers on bumps. This one doesn't flicker. It stays on. Steady. At sixty.
shots.scene: ECU DASH, tighter on the door diagram and the needle at 60.
shots.visual_change: Wheels hit a road seam: the needle shivers ±1 mph, the RL segment does not flicker.

shots.line: Something is holding that door.
shots.scene: Wide exterior side view. Camera locked to the car; road and lamps scroll past.
shots.purpose: The narrator's cover story. The frame shows nothing outside.
shots.visual_change: Rear-left door exterior: no hand, nothing on the handle.

shots.line: Press Lock All. Once.
shots.scene: ECU centre console: LOCK ALL button, coffee cup in the holder beside it.
shots.purpose: Rule 1, second half: the act the ending turns against YOU.
shots.visual_change: Button's padlock glyph lights green. Coffee surface still.

shots.line: Four clicks. Every door locked. Now drive.
shots.scene: ECU driver-door sill: lock pin drops; DASH padlock glyph appears in the corner.
shots.visual_change: Lock pin drops 8 mm.

shots.scene: Black card.

shots.line: Back at pump six, you went inside to pay.
shots.scene: Wide: the shop interior from behind the counter. YOU at the till; the car at pump 6 through the window. 0.4 s cross-fade in.
shots.purpose: Flashback to the moment it got in.
shots.visual_change: Pump 6 screen lit. Outside, the car sits dark.

shots.line: You left the car unlocked. It was only two minutes.
shots.scene: Medium exterior: YOU walking to the car, coffee in the left hand, paper bag in the right arm.
shots.purpose: Plant: the dome light is still fading as YOU walks back (a door closed seconds ago).
shots.visual_change: Inside the car, the dome light glows warm and fades to off over 1.5 s as YOU arrives.

shots.line: Your bag went on the passenger seat. Your coffee went in the holder.
shots.scene: ECU passenger seat from the driver's side; the PAB lamp at the top edge of frame.
shots.purpose: Plant the baseline: a light bag leaves the passenger airbag OFF; plant the coffee.
shots.visual_change: Bag rests upright; cushion barely dents. PAB lamp reads PASSENGER AIRBAG OFF.

shots.line: Your mirror was tilted down. You fixed it without thinking.
shots.scene: ECU rear-view mirror, tilted down: its glass shows the rear-left cushion, dented.
shots.purpose: Plant: someone in the back moved the mirror.

shots.scene: ECU exterior rear-left door seam as the car leaves pump 6.
shots.purpose: Plant: the rear-left door is visibly unlatched as the car rolls out.
shots.visual_change: A 1 cm dark gap along the rear-left door edge, unchanged as the car moves.

shots.line: Rule two. Keep the needle above twenty.
shots.scene: Rule card over the dimmed speedometer.

shots.line: Lock All can't hold a door that isn't latched. Rear left isn't.
shots.scene: ECU DASH door diagram with the padlock glyph.
shots.purpose: Escalation: locking was not enough (and the viewer learns the door is unlatched).
shots.visual_change: Padlock lit, but the RL door panel in the diagram is drawn swung 10° out.

shots.line: At speed, a hand outside can only hold on. It needs you slow to pull it open.
shots.scene: ECU exterior rear-left handle at 60 mph.
shots.purpose: Cover story; the frame contradicts it (no hand).
shots.visual_change: Handle empty; a sodium pool slides across it.

shots.line: Exit twelve. You have to take it.
shots.scene: Wide exterior: overhead green sign EXIT 12, lit by the headlights.
shots.visual_change: Sign rushes toward camera.

shots.line: You'll want to brake for the ramp. Everyone brakes for the ramp. Lift off the gas instead. Let the curve take the speed.
shots.scene: Close-up YOU's right foot in the footwell.
shots.purpose: Micro-habit (braking) replaced by an easing action.

shots.line: Forty. Thirty. Twenty-two. The light flickers. It's pulling harder.
shots.scene: ECU DASH: needle and RL segment together.
shots.purpose: The tracker reacts to speed (cover story). Truthfully, it is shifting its weight.
shots.visual_change: Needle sweeps 40→30→22; RL flickers off/on (2 frames) at 22, 0.5 s before 'flickers'.

shots.line: Twenty-one. The ramp straightens. Thirty again.
shots.scene: Wide top-down of the curving ramp; the car follows the curve.
shots.visual_change: Headlight cones sweep along the guardrail.

shots.line: Steady red.
shots.scene: ECU of the RL segment only (tightest framing).
shots.visual_change: RL steady again.

shots.line: Rule three. Don't turn on the dome light.
shots.scene: Rule card over the dimmed roof liner.

shots.line: Your thumb knows where the switch is.
shots.scene: ECU overhead console: dome switch with the PAB lamp beside it.
shots.purpose: Micro-habit: reaching for the dome switch.
shots.visual_change: PAB lamp reads OFF.

shots.line: Light the cabin, glance back, done. Everyone does. Don't.
shots.scene: Close-up YOU, eyes up toward the switch.
shots.purpose: Name the habit and stop it.

shots.line: A lit cabin shows it which seat you're in. Even reaching is enough. Look. The light just moved to your door.
shots.scene: ECU DASH door diagram.
shots.purpose: Escalation: the warning jumps to YOU's own door.
shots.visual_change: RL goes dark; the front-left (driver) segment lights red, 0.5 s before 'Look'.

shots.line: Hand back on the wheel.
shots.scene: Medium from the passenger side: driver's door panel, inside handle, lock pin down.
shots.purpose: Obey; show the door that lit.
shots.visual_change: Inside handle sits still.

shots.line: It goes back to rear left.
shots.scene: ECU DASH door diagram, wider (includes the speed readout).
shots.visual_change: Driver segment off; RL back on.

shots.scene: Medium side cross-section of the cabin (driver and rear seat visible).
shots.purpose: Plant: a streetlight sweep shows the rear-left cushion dented.
shots.visual_change: Rear-left cushion pressed 4 cm, nothing visible on it.

shots.line: Rule four. At a red light, never shift into park.
shots.scene: Rule card over the dimmed street.

shots.line: The first light on Harlan turns red. The road is empty. You stop anyway.
shots.scene: Wide exterior: empty avenue, traffic signal ahead; the car rolls to a stop at the line.
shots.visual_change: Signal yellow → red 0.5 s before 'red'.

shots.line: Long lights make people shift into park.
shots.scene: ECU gear selector with YOU's hand on it.

shots.line: Your car unlocks every door in park.
shots.scene: ECU DASH gear readout 'D' beside the padlock glyph.
shots.visual_change: Padlock locked; 'D' lit.

shots.line: Foot on the brake. Stay in drive.
shots.scene: Close-up YOU's right foot on the brake pedal.

shots.line: Zero miles an hour. A chime. A new light. Rear seat, left side. Seatbelt unbuckled.
shots.scene: ECU DASH rear-row seat diagram beside the door diagram.
shots.purpose: Escalation 1 → 2: the rear seat sensor says someone is sitting behind YOU.
shots.visual_change: Speed 0. The rear-left seat icon lights red with an unbuckled-belt glyph, 0.5 s before 'A chime'.

shots.line: Rear sensors misread bags. You know that. Let it chime.
shots.scene: Close-up YOU in red signal light.
shots.purpose: Cover story; the viewer knows the bag is in front.

shots.line: Green. Go. Above twenty.
shots.scene: Wide exterior: the signal turns green; the car pulls away.
shots.visual_change: Signal red → green.

shots.line: Rule five. Don't touch the mirror.
shots.scene: Rule card over the dimmed mirror.

shots.line: It's tilted again. Up, at the roof. The bumps did that.
shots.scene: ECU rear-view mirror, tilted up 8°: the glass shows only roof liner.
shots.purpose: Clue: the mirror moved again, now so YOU can't see the back seat.
shots.visual_change: Mirror angle changed since YOU fixed it in SC13.

shots.line: You'll want to set it right. Everyone does.
shots.scene: Medium YOU from the passenger side, mirror at the top of frame.

shots.line: See a face at the rear window, and you'll brake. And braking is slow.
shots.scene: Close-up YOU, eyes forward; the hand lowers back to the wheel at frame edge.

shots.line: Pull over under the next streetlight.
shots.scene: Close-up YOU, three-quarter: the centre screen glows at frame right.
shots.purpose: The breach begins: the same voice, but from the car.
shots.visual_change: Centre screen switches from the map to a bright blue call screen.

shots.line: Get out and check the rear-left latch yourself.
shots.scene: ECU MEDIA screen: INCOMING AUDIO / UNKNOWN DEVICE with a live waveform.
shots.purpose: The one true instruction in the film.
shots.visual_change: Waveform moves with the voice.

shots.line: Please disregard that last instruction. Do not take your foot off the gas.
shots.scene: Same MEDIA screen: a 4-frame static bar cut, then the map returns.
shots.purpose: The narrator overrides the breach (pays off in the ending).
shots.visual_change: Static bar (diegetic failure), then the normal map.

shots.scene: Wide exterior: one tall streetlamp ahead; the car passes through its pool.
shots.purpose: YOU passes the streetlight the voice meant, without slowing.
shots.visual_change: Car keeps its speed.

shots.line: The rear window fogs in one small patch. That's the cold. Keep driving.
shots.scene: ECU rear window from outside, behind the car.
shots.purpose: Clue: breath on the inside of the glass.
shots.visual_change: A palm-sized fog patch blooms and fades on the inside of the glass.

shots.line: Rule six. Passenger airbag light on? Both hands on the wheel.
shots.scene: Rule card over the dimmed passenger seat.

shots.line: The rear seat light goes out.
shots.scene: ECU DASH rear-row seat diagram.
shots.visual_change: RB goes dark.

shots.line: Then the small light under your mirror changes. Passenger airbag. Off. Then on.
shots.scene: ECU overhead console PAB lamp (as in SC24).
shots.purpose: Escalation 3: an adult's weight on the seat beside YOU.
shots.visual_change: PAB OFF → ON, 0.5 s before 'Then on'.

shots.line: That sensor wakes for an adult's weight. Your bag weighs two pounds. It tips into the footwell. The seat beside you sinks.
shots.scene: ECU passenger seat (same angle as SC12).
shots.visual_change: Cushion sinks 3 cm; the bag tips and slides into the footwell; the seatbelt buckle sways.

shots.line: The console lid is still shut. Your coffee hasn't spilled.
shots.scene: ECU centre console: closed armrest lid, coffee cup in the holder.
shots.purpose: Proof it did not climb over.
shots.visual_change: Coffee surface still; lid shut.

shots.line: Nothing climbed over.
shots.scene: Close-up YOU, eyes flick right 10° and back.

shots.line: You'll want to reach right. Push the bag back. Feel the seat. Don't. Both hands on the wheel.
shots.scene: Medium from the windshield: YOU and the passenger seat side by side.
shots.visual_change: Passenger seat dented, empty-looking.

shots.line: The rear-left light goes out. Behind you, the door clicks shut.
shots.scene: ECU DASH door diagram, centred on the rear-left panel.
shots.purpose: The door warning ends: nothing is holding that door any more.
shots.visual_change: Car crosses a road seam; nothing is holding the door now, so it swings in and latches. RL goes dark 0.5 s before the line.

shots.line: It's on your side of the car now. Leaning on the passenger door. That's all the sensor feels.
shots.scene: Close-up YOU in profile; the passenger window behind, dark and empty.
shots.purpose: The narrator's last cover story; the viewer has already seen the dent inside.
shots.visual_change: Passenger window exterior: nothing.

shots.line: Rule seven. Close the garage before you open your door.
shots.scene: Rule card over the dimmed house front.

shots.line: Birch Lane. Forty-one.
shots.scene: Wide exterior: house 41 with an attached garage and a porch light.
shots.visual_change: Porch light on.

shots.line: You'll want to stop in the driveway. Run for the front door. Everyone does. Don't. Out there, every door is a way in.
shots.scene: Close-up YOU looking left at the porch.
shots.purpose: Micro-habit: the dash for the front door.

shots.line: Pull into the garage.
shots.scene: Wide exterior: the car drives into the open garage.
shots.visual_change: Garage opener bulb on.

shots.line: Press the remote on your visor.
shots.scene: ECU visor remote button.
shots.visual_change: Remote LED blinks red.

shots.line: Watch the door come down in your side mirror.
shots.scene: ECU driver's side mirror showing the garage door descending.
shots.visual_change: Door panels descend in the mirror glass.

shots.line: The streetlight shrinks to a line under it. Then nothing. Sealed.
shots.scene: Wide interior garage side view: car, garage door, floor.
shots.visual_change: Door reaches the floor; the streetlight wedge on the concrete narrows to a line, then disappears.

shots.line: Now you can shift into park. Every door unlocks.
shots.scene: ECU gear selector (as in SC32), now moving.
shots.purpose: Payoff of Rule 4: the rules only cared until the garage was sealed.
shots.visual_change: DASH padlock glyph opens.

shots.line: Engine off.
shots.scene: ECU start button; YOU's finger presses it.
shots.visual_change: DASH dims to accessory mode; the PAB lamp stays lit.

shots.line: Here's what the dashboard never told you.
shots.scene: ECU dimmed DASH; the door diagram all dark.

shots.line: The door light only wakes above five miles an hour.
shots.scene: ECU speedometer low arc (0–10 mph only), labelled; a new, tighter framing than SC01.
shots.purpose: Reveal 1: the 5 mph trigger seen in SC01.
shots.visual_change: Needle creeps 0→4 with RL dark; at 5 it lights.

shots.line: The door was open before you started the car. It opened while you paid.
shots.scene: Wide from inside the shop (as SC10), desaturated, but the camera now looks past YOU at the car.
shots.purpose: Reveal 2: the door, the thunk and the dome light.
shots.visual_change: Outside: the car's dome light on; the rear-left door swings nearly shut and stops 1 cm short.

shots.line: You pressed Lock All. You locked it in with you.
shots.scene: ECU Lock All button (as SC07), desaturated, with the rear-left lock pin in focus behind it.
shots.visual_change: Glyph lights green; behind it, the rear-left pin drops while the door edge stays open.

shots.line: Every rule kept the car moving. Every rule kept it sealed. All the way home. Into a closed garage.
shots.scene: Wide interior garage (as SC62), back in the present.
shots.visual_change: The opener bulb switches off (timer).

shots.line: One instruction could have saved you. You were told to disregard it.
shots.scene: ECU MEDIA screen, dark, with a faint burned-in ghost of 'Unknown device'.
shots.visual_change: The ghost text fades.

shots.line: The dome light comes on by itself. Now you can see the seat beside you.
shots.scene: Medium interior: YOU and the passenger seat from the windshield (as SC53).
shots.visual_change: Dome light fades up warm; the passenger cushion is deeply dented; the bag lies in the footwell.

shots.line: The belt pulls out. Slowly. Across nothing. Click.
shots.scene: ECU passenger seat belt and buckle.
shots.visual_change: Webbing pays out 40 cm across the empty seat and latches; the passenger-belt glyph goes dark.

shots.line: It isn't going anywhere.
shots.scene: Close-up YOU under the dome light.

shots.line: Tomorrow, your dashboard will be clear. Every door shut. Passenger airbag, on.
shots.scene: ECU DASH, same framing as SC01.
shots.purpose: Reinterpreting final image: the mirror of SC01.
shots.visual_change: Dome light fades out; every door segment dark; the PAB lamp glows 'Passenger airbag ON' at the top edge.
